swipeComponent.event:
local offset = component:scrollOffset() local first = element:parent():GetElement("InfoContent"):GetComponent("Text") if first then if ( first:getOrientationPosition().y ~= offset ) then first:setOrientationPosition(Vector2(first("xOffset"):GetInt(), offset))
